description: This file defines a function 'displayIndicatorField' used for rendering an indicator field in the SuiteCRM email modules. It includes license and copyright notices, checks for valid entry point, and contains logic to retrieve email bean data and render a Smarty template.

methods.name: displayIndicatorField
methods.description: Renders an indicator field for email records using Smarty templates, retrieving email beans as needed based on provided focus data.
